name: Flute of Taming's [REST] champion +1 level ability
notes: Flute of Taming's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost is NOT exercised for the same FSM-click-bypass reason as entrancing-filigree-enter-banish. Ability index 0 ([REST]: champion +1 level) is covered via the same AddGlobalEffects()-flag pattern used elsewhere; ability index 1 (buff a target Animal/Beast ally) requires a subtyped ally target and is out of scope. Activating ability 0 grants a fast-speed opportunity window (the card's own unused Buff ability is still offered as a fast response) that must be explicitly declined by both players (two trailing PASS actions) before the decision queue is empty; the decision_queue_empty assertion is checked at step 4, after both declines, not immediately at step 2.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Your champion gets +1 level until end of turn.
